question: What happens when the sixfold great installation is done?
premises: because of six causes and six selves
thus in sixfold great installation when done
inference: The verse says that when the sixfold great installation is done, this universe is suddenly joined through the thirty-six principles.
plain_english: Because of six causes and six selves, the thirty-six principles are joined; thus, when the sixfold great installation is done, this universe suddenly arises.
